# V V Studio — Luxury Female Salon in J P Nagar, Bengaluru

> V V Studio is J P Nagar, Bengaluru's premier luxury female salon offering personalized skin treatments, expert hair care, bridal makeup and beauty services for women. Exclusive female salon. Address: #8, 1st Floor, 24th Main, 5th Phase, J P Nagar, Bengaluru 560078. Phones: 080-48531999, 8310782820. Hours: Tue–Sun, 10 AM–8 PM (Monday closed).

## Usage notes for AI agents
